changed.title: Exact weighted average support of binary parity contradictions when deleting any one equation preserves inconsistency
changed.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (row : Fin m → Fin n → ZMod 2) (rhs : Fin m → ZMod 2),
  let ok := fun (rows : Finset (Fin m)) => ∃ x : Fin n → ZMod 2,
    ∀ e ∈ rows, (∑ j, row e j * x j) = rhs e
  let W := Finset.univ.filter (fun indices : Finset (Fin m) =>
    (∀ j : Fin n, indices.sum (fun e => row e j) = 0) ∧ indices.sum rhs = 1)
  ¬ ok Finset.univ → (∀ e : Fin m, ¬ ok (Finset.univ.erase e)) →
    W.Nonempty ∧
    (∀ e ∈ W.biUnion id, 2*(W.filter (fun subset => e ∈ subset)).card = W.card) ∧
    ∀ w : Fin m → ℕ,
      2*W.sum (fun support => support.sum w) = W.card * (W.biUnion id).sum w ∧
      ∃ D ∈ W, 2*D.sum w ≤ (W.biUnion id).sum w
changed.unlocks: halves the total weight needed for an odd binary dependency when every single row deletion preserves inconsistency
changed.context: Deletion of coordinate e supplies a contradiction avoiding e by the binary solvability criterion. If e occurs, also pick one containing it. Their symmetric difference has zero left and right sums and contains e. Toggling this difference pairs all contradictions containing e with those avoiding it. Sum the coordinate counts against the weights and select a member of at most the average weight.

changed.title: Digit sums and a binary syndrome color every squared-distance bucket on a finite grid
changed.statement:
∀ (m b h : ℕ), 0 < b →
  let Q := 2^b
  let X := Fin m → Fin Q
  let width := m*Q^2 / 2^h + 1
  let distance := fun (x y : X) => ∑ j : Fin m, (Nat.dist (x j).val (y j).val)^2
  let bucket := fun (x y : X) => distance x y / width
  let f := 1+m+b*width
  let vec := fun (x : X) (i : Fin m × Fin b) => if (x i.1).val.testBit i.2.val then
    (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  (∀ x y : X, bucket x y < 2^h) ∧
    ∃ H : ((Fin m × Fin b) → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin f → ZMod 2),
      (∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin m => x j ≠ y j)).card ≤ width →
        H (vec x) ≠ H (vec y)) ∧
      ∀ p q : X × X, p ≠ q → bucket p.1 p.2 = bucket q.1 q.2 →
        (∀ j, (p.1 j).val + (p.2 j).val = (q.1 j).val + (q.2 j).val) →
        H (vec p.1) = H (vec q.1) →
        bucket p.1 q.2 < bucket p.1 p.2 ∧ bucket q.1 p.2 < bucket p.1 p.2
changed.unlocks: prices the syndrome and proves agreement for a tag applied to every possible pair of raw payloads
changed.context: Every squared distance is below 2^h times the bucket width W. A difference supported on at most W digits is specified by its support mask and at most W b-bit values in position order. Some binary matrix with 1+m+bW rows detects them all by the union bound. Equal sums and distinct equal-syndrome left endpoints imply their squared distance exceeds W. Each crossed squared distance is the average of the two original distances minus that quantity. Both crosses fall strictly below the common bucket.

changed.title: Mixed row and column OR pools price paired-decoder errors by ternary colorings with separate pin budgets
changed.statement:
∀ (n q : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin n → Bool) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)),
  let I := Fin n
  let P := Fin q
  let pools := fun (R C : P → Finset I) (x y : I) (j : P) => decide (x ∈ R j ∨ π y ∈ C j)
  let loss := fun (R C : P → Finset I) (out : Finset I → (P → Bool) → Bool) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun z =>
      out {z.1,z.2} (pools R C z.1 z.2) ≠ G z.1 (π z.2))).card
  ∀ (r c e : ℕ),
    (∃ (R C : P → Finset I) (out : Finset I → (P → Bool) → Bool),
      (∑ j, (R j).card) ≤ r ∧ (∑ j, (C j).card) ≤ c ∧ loss R C out ≤ e) ↔
    ∃ f : I → P → Fin 3,
      (∑ j : P, ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun v => f v j = 1)).card) ≤ r ∧
      (∑ j : P, ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun w => f w j = 2)).card) ≤ c ∧
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun z => z.1 < z.2 ∧
        f z.1 = f z.2 ∧ G z.1 (π z.2) ≠ G z.2 (π z.1))).card ≤ e
changed.unlocks: characterizes fixed-matching decoder error by ternary labels with separate row and column pin budgets
changed.context: A pool assigns each matched label to neither bank, row only, column only, or both. The initial three types distinguish every unequal pair under reversal. Both distinguishes none, so replacing it by neither preserves every distinction and saves its two pins. Realize the three digits by physical memberships. The OR bank identifies the unordered pair. Equal addresses leave its two orientations merged, costing one cell exactly when the target bits differ. Unequal addresses allow both orientations to be read.

changed.title: The Boolean degree of each second-channel image bounds the number of common words per third-channel tag
changed.statement:
∀ (k r c : ℕ),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin k → F
  let Z := Fin r → F
  let W := X × Z
  ∀ (send : W → X) (tag : W → Fin c → Bool),
    (∀ a b t : W, a.1 = b.1 → send b = send t → tag t = tag a → a = b ∧ b = t) →
    let volume := fun d : ℕ => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (min k d + 1), k.choose j
    (∀ d : ℕ,
      (∀ u : X, ∃ coeff : Finset (Fin k) → F, ∀ y : X,
        (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset (Fin k) => S.card ≤ d),
          coeff S * ∏ j ∈ S, y j) =
        (if y ∈ Finset.univ.image (fun z : Z => send (u,z)) then (1 : F) else 0)) →
      (∀ h : Fin c → Bool, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : W => tag w = h)).card ≤ volume d) ∧
      2^(k+r) ≤ 2^c * volume d) ∧
    ((∀ u : X, ∃ (A : Z →ₗ[F] X) (v : X), ∀ z : Z, send (u,z) = A z + v) →
      r ≤ k ∧ 2^(k+r) ≤ 2^c * volume (k-r))
changed.unlocks: bounds the number of words per tag before optimizing the conditional affine witness
changed.context: Fix a third tag. Two distinct words with this tag cannot share a short endpoint or have a cross pair in the image, since that pair supplies a middle word. The row-image indicators, evaluated at the selected second strings, give an identity matrix. Degree-d indicators lie in the span of the square-free monomials of size at most d, bounding each tag class by that dimension. Sum over tags. Affine suffix maps are injective in each row. Their images have codimension k-r and membership is a product of k-r affine tests.
